operations.description: ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) FastEndpoints service for DiscoveryService; generates its OpenAPI document at /swagger/v1/swagger.json and accepts accommodations from providers.
operations.evidence: Reported by the assistant; the repository is not an Nx workspace

operations.name: Accommodation Intake
operations.description: Receives Accommodation submissions from providers over POST /accommodations, validates them and keeps them in a process-local in-memory store for the lifetime of the service.

operations.label: Provides accommodation (POST /accommodations, JSON)
operations.evidence: Reported by the assistant; the repository is not an Nx workspace

operations.name: ProvideAccommodation endpoint
operations.description: FastEndpoints endpoint for POST /accommodations (operationId ProvideAccommodation) with its validator. It rejects bodies missing required Accommodation/Location fields with 400, stores valid ones and answers 204; its metadata is the source of the published contract.

operations.name: In-memory accommodation store
operations.description: IAccommodationStore and its ConcurrentQueue-backed singleton implementation, which hold copies of received accommodations. It is non-durable by design: entries are lost on restart and not shared between instances.
